raw_text:
PLAN "28F Recreational Lifter — Cycle-aware 12-week Strength"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with cycle-aware modulation"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 (Adaptation)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower - Moderate":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper - Moderate":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full - Low Intensity (Flow days safe)":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - Progress":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper - Progress":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Flow-friendly Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Lower - Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Upper - Strength":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Flow-friendly Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_tilt 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper - Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          band_face_pull face_pull 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          neck_roll 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Flow-safe Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2 (Hypertrophy/Strength)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Build":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Build":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Flow-adjusted Conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x45..60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_tilt 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Heavy-ish":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          good_morning 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Heavy-ish":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 5x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Flow-safe Active":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Lower - Volume":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 65m "Upper - Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          neck_roll 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Flow-modulated Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower - Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper - Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Flow-safe Mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3 (Strength Peak & Maintenance)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Lower - Strength Peak":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 180 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Upper - Strength Peak":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 5x3 rpe 9 rest 180 seconds
          barbell_row 4x4 rpe 8..9 rest 150 seconds
          tricep_extension 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Flow-aware Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x60 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          pelvic_tilt 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Lower - Maintain":
        warmup:
          cycling 10m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 65m "Upper - Maintain":
        warmup:
          rowing 10m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          seated_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Flow-modulated Session":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower - Slight Volume":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          trap_bar_deadlift 3x5 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Upper - Slight Volume":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m

          bench_press 4x6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds

      DAY Friday training 40m "Flow-safe Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Deload & Assess":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Deload Upper":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds

      DAY Friday training 40m "Flow-aware Recovery":

          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          plank 3x45 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
